scope: scripts/probe_safety_logic.py on a frozen Debug build of d681ece1 (artifacts/w2bs4, git archive), 24/24 steps, in an owned scratch holding the standard CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 and an added CPU 1511F-1 PN V4.1 (configureScratchSecurity, failsafeRuntimeAccess; owned scratch only) with an ET 200SP station and two F-DI 8x24VDC HF. project_simulation_enable with no plcPath applied in this two-PLC project with checkpoint, a compile of every device (ScratchStation, TiaMcpFStation, TiaMcpRemoteIo; zero errors, device-path-v1 receipt) and save, where the one-PLC compile of earlier builds refused AmbiguousTarget (sl1) or left the other PLC inconsistent so the fingerprint refused (sl2). Then safety_inspect (no safety password, not logged on), two standard tags and a safety_import_xml of Main_Safety_RTG1 with two F-FBD networks: V21 refused the import natively ('The element Address has an invalid scope GlobalVariable', the probe's own XML for the absolute F-DI input) and the change was restored from its checkpoint. PLCSIM was not reached.
limitations: Covers project_simulation_enable in a project with two PLCs (enable only) and the restore of a natively refused safety import; no F-logic behavior, PLCSIM download or F-I/O injection.
The scratch user's fail-safe access exists in the owned scratch only; no safety login, password, acceptance or download.
